author_static.launched: as static_before_observe, with W2's records as capture paths

environment_file.content: the canonical JSON of the declared environment, no trailing newline

refusal_or_failure.files: before the attempt directory exists, none; after it exists, whatever the observer published, with failure.json and result.json when it could write them, and each attempted command's failure.json and postflight.json
refusal_or_failure.stderr: one line: ontokin.current-host-readback-observation-refusal/0.2.0 with error {code, reason, state, cause, details}; names of environment variables only, never their values
refusal_or_failure.then: FAILURE-CAPTURE sections 3 to 8 and MR-PLAN section 9; no retry

host.next: an independent HOST review before any configuration binds it (MR-PLAN S5)

success.observer_document_mode: 0o600 (the supervisor writes its own three files per command)
success.stdout: one line: the canonical result, schema ontokin.current-host-readback-observation-result/0.2.0, mode observe, state OBSERVED_UNAPPROVED, evidence_finalized true, starts node exact 1 and other exact 1, with the descriptors of HOST, the result and the completion

expected_starts.director_launcher: one start of the framework interpreter for observe, and one for static before it, both through <worktree>/.venv/bin/python with -I -S -B; MR-PLAN section 8 does not count them as bounded starts, and they are recorded
never_started: any Git other than the bound file
any Node other than the planned bin/node
a second observe under this plan
expected_starts.order_of_work: plan digest, plan shape, environment, platform and boot, OS identity, source inventory and HEAD, launcher and Python inventory, packages, loaded modules, runtime (Node's bytes and Mach-O), reader tree, Git binding, failure capture, evidence ancestors and absent attempt; then the supervisor import, the loaded-module check, the attempt directories, Git --version, and Node --version last (W3-OBSERVER section 7)

fc_k3: Each of the two runs gets a command record beside the attempt, never inside it: the exact argv with the digest, the cwd, environment_file above by path and SHA-256, the UTC start and end, the wall time and kern.bootsessionuuid before and after. Suggested paths: <local>/c271-p36/evidence/observe-001.static.command-record.json and <local>/c271-p36/evidence/observe-001.observe.command-record.json.

observe.capture_rule: FAILURE-CAPTURE FC-K2: stdout, stderr and the exit status go into fresh files beside the attempt, never inside it, each absent before the start. A redirect into the attempt would create it first, and the observer would refuse (EVIDENCE-FRESH).
observe.digest_argument: exactly one further argv element after --plan-sha256: the plan's 64-character lowercase SHA-256 as the review record of observation plan 001 states it
observe.shell_form: cd <local>/c271-p36/evidence && /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 <worktree>/.venv/bin/python -I -S -B <worktree>/prototypes/static_tray_v01/current_host_observation_v02.py observe --plan <local>/c271-p36/workers/W2-plan-001/observation-plan-001.json --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" > <local>/c271-p36/evidence/observe-001.observe.stdout.txt 2> <local>/c271-p36/evidence/observe-001.observe.stderr.txt; echo $? > <local>/c271-p36/evidence/observe-001.observe.exit.txt
observe.shell_form_variable: PLAN_SHA256 is set by the Director, in the same shell immediately before this line, to the review record's digest. That shell expands it into the final argument; env -i passes no variable of that name to the observer.

plan.digest: not recorded here; taken from the review record by the Director
